_README._scope: PHOTOS for Huron's CIVIC/RECREATION slice: listings.json records with category community|parks|historic|arts, no photos, a website set. 46 records, built fresh from cartograph/data/huron/content/listings.json and sorted by prominence_rank.
_README._already_done_elsewhere: Christ Episcopal Church (0236), BGSU Firelands (0195/0280), Cedar Point Center (0226), Huron Historical Society (0212) and Upside Down Art Studio (0146) were photographed by earlier passes (civic-deep.json, prominent-photos.json) and are not revisited here.
_README._method: Direct curl of each website (WebSearch not used). For every candidate image: subject evidence scored from caption, alt text, descriptive filename, CDN path and the heading of the block it sits in. Images whose subject could not be established from the page were DOWNLOADED TO A SCRATCH DIR AND LOOKED AT before being recorded; nothing is rehosted and no image is recorded on filename alone.
_README._identity_gate: Every site was checked for a Huron, Ohio (44839) / Erie County address, phone or town name BEFORE any image was taken. Four sites failed that gate outright and are recorded with _url_finding and zero photos.
_README._licences: No open licence was found on any of these 46. The Commons/NRHP route that served Christ Episcopal Church produced nothing new here (see _no_photos_reason on the city records). Municipal photographs are recorded with the City of Huron as credit and NO licence claimed - a city publication is not a federal work.
